description: 400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

docs.title: 400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

node.reason: FilePurpose is a closed enum: the native constructor rejects invalid-purpose before HTTP, so a type-correct snippet cannot demonstrate this HTTP 400 response.

wasm.reason: WasmFilePurpose contains only declared members; InvalidPurpose does not exist. Accessing that absent JavaScript member yields undefined and coerces to Assistants, so it cannot demonstrate an invalid-purpose HTTP request.

skip.reason: Typed FilePurpose bindings reject invalid values before HTTP (Rust/Python/Kotlin/C#/Ruby/Node/Go). WASM exposes only declared enum members; an undeclared JavaScript member is undefined and coerces to Assistants, so it cannot send this invalid-purpose request. HTTP 400 is therefore not exercised by these bindings.

error.message: Invalid value for 'purpose': 'invalid-purpose'. Supported values are: 'fine-tune', 'assistants', 'batch'.
